items.t: Sudden loss of power steering assist (recall)
items.job: Replace power steering pump and lines
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Corroded fuel pump connector can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace fuel pump connector
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Sliding door latch can freeze and not latch (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Liftgate struts can corrode and let the hatch fall (recall)
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN or ask a Mazda dealer.

items.t: Worn front struts and control arms
items.note: A front control arm adds about 1.5 hours per side plus parts.

items.t: Rear shock leaks or broken top mount rattles
items.note: Samarins puts it at about $140–$230 per side.

items.t: Front sway bar bushings rattle
Uneven or fast tire wear
items.note: Owners report about $800 for new tires.

items.t: Worn top engine mount
Automatic transmission failure
items.note: Owners report an average of about $2,500.

items.t: Jerky shifting from a failed transmission control module
Manual clutch slips or wears out early
Starts in Neutral but not in Park
items.job: Clean and lubricate shift cable pivot

items.t: Rust on body panels
items.note: Cost depends heavily on how far the rust has spread.

items.t: A/C stops cooling from a failed compressor clutch
items.job: Replace A/C compressor clutch or compressor
items.note: A clutch kit alone is at the low end; a full compressor runs about $1,300.

items.t: Check engine light from a stuck-open thermostat
Burns oil at higher mileage
items.note: Engine repair for heavy oil burning costs far more; owners whose engines failed report about $5,400.

items.t: Bluetooth module drains the battery
items.job: Battery drain test and replace Bluetooth module

items.t: Third brake light stops working
items.job: Replace third brake light connector or light

items.t: Check engine light from a leaking EVAP vent valve
Brief ticking noise on start-up
items.note: If the timing actuator is worn, repair costs several hundred dollars more.

items.t: Sliding door lock hard to operate
items.job: Adjust and lubricate sliding door lock

items.t: Fuel pump nozzle clicks off and tank is hard to fill
